best_for: Linux and Windows users who want an open-source music player without ads or tracking, and who are willing to pick and set up plugins for their music source.

points.title: Plugins supply the music
points.text: Spotube does not have its own catalog. Plugins written by the community, or by you, bring in metadata, playlists and audio from other services, so what you can play depends on the plugins you install.

points.title: No telemetry
points.text: The README states the app collects no telemetry, diagnostics or user data, and playback is controlled on your own device.

points.title: Offline and lyrics
points.text: Tracks can be downloaded with tagged metadata, and time-synced lyrics are shown whatever plugin you use.

points.title: Version 6 is a rewrite
points.text: 6.0.0 moved the app from Flutter to Compose Multiplatform with a new interface, rebuilt the plugin system on Kotlin with automatic plugin updates, and added Jam sessions for synced group listening. Old plugins may not carry over.

points.title: License changed to AGPL
points.text: With 6.0.0 the license changed from BSD-4-Clause to AGPL-3.0-or-later. It stays free to use.

points.title: Windows and Linux here
points.text: Windows installs per user and needs Windows 10 or later; the listing keeps 34 versions. The Flathub build is verified as the project's own, on x64 and Arm64, and lists only the current release. No macOS build is listed on this site.
